name: story-blocks
vibe: An edited-video story told in bold color blocks — panels of terracotta, olive and cream slide in from alternating sides, kinetic Caprasimo words keep living after they land, internal jump-cut beats change the shot mid-scene, and whip-pan cuts throw the film from panel to panel. One idea per block, no fluff between. For brand stories, explainers, product narratives and feeds that need cutting through.
